name: Pablo: Next Level
overview: Pablo has joined a new school and it’s strange, wild and definitely complicated. From rules that don’t always make sense to chaotic corridors, Pablo is navigating this strange new world one drama at a time, with a little “help” from his book animal friends and a whole lot of imagination. Through art and creativity, Pablo makes sense of the things that feel impossible to untangle, revealing a world that’s funny, heartfelt, and deeply relatable.
